data.name: The Spy Who Shrunk Me
data.detailed_description:
Nova atualização



Quaternion Identity
💃 Infiltrate a night club split into two by the Berlin Wall in Audrey's final mission!
🎶 New cutscenes, music, voice acting and more!
🎀 New collectibles, achievements and an epic epilogue!



Virtual Reality & Technological Difficulties
🥽 Entire game available in delicious SteamVR!
🪁 Play your way with three difficulty levels!
🎥 Watch out for laser walls and security cameras now in all levels!



Get Comfy!
🏡 Visit Audrey Smoothspy's home and spybase!
🎁 Find 10 collectibles scattered around all missions!
🚀 Performance improvements!



Corporate Transparency
🕶 See enemies through walls with the Spytacles, a new gadget!
📉 Expanded "Mind of Madness" and "Mind of Madness, Redux" missions
🔨 Bug fixes galore!



Operation: Improbable
🔫 An all-new mission that takes you deep into the secret vault of CON-NEX!
⏱ Stop time itself with the Stopwatch, a new gadget!
🎮 Full controller support included!


Acerca do jogo

OVERVIEW

THE SPY WHO SHRUNK ME is a stealth game where you are a superspy armed with a shrink ray! It's 1981. Sneak onto a train inbound to Moscow and infiltrate a software company that harbors grave secrets bound to turn the Cold War into a very hot one. Armed with banana peels, airbag mines and the capability to shrink enemies and drop them in toilets and paper shredders, you are the only one standing between the dreaded General Bolscotchkovich and his Soviet army.

The Spy Who Shrunk Me is inspired by Ant-Man & Austin Powers while being a gigantic love letter to the legendary No One Lives Forever series of games.

AN EPIC STEALTH ESCAPADE

  • 🕵 Be agent AUDREY SMOOTHSPY, the only agent aloof enough to fight the Soviet army all by herself. Armed with a stolen Soviet shrink ray, an assorted inventory of spy gadgets and some banana peels, you're the only one affordable enough for the job of saving the free world!

  • 👢 Keep the cold war communist regime under your heels (literally) by (also literally) flushing their cronies down the toilet! Manipulate your enemies size using your trusty shrink ray. And when the going gets tough, zip past enemies as a tiny shrunk spy.

  • 👒Audrey's adventure takes you all the way to MOSCOW and BERLIN to find out what a sinister software company office complex is actually hiding within! Sneak aboard a train, defuse a nuke and kidnap a scientist into a purse! Don't get caught or risk getting stomped on!

  • 🎶 A fully voice-acted narrative adventure with multiple endings and music that makes you want to jam Soviets down paper shredders!

  • 🔮 Play your way! Challenge yourself by completing the adventure without killing anyone or without getting detected.

reviews.review:
[h1]Positive Aspects[/h1]
🔹Smooth stealth mechanics.
🔹Pure Comedy.
🔹Despite its comedic style it does have a nice story.
🔹Voice acting.

[h1]Negative Aspects[/h1]
🔸Very Short for someone that has a lot of experience in stealth games.
🔸Game needs more of a tutorial.


[h1]Introduction[/h1]
The Spy Who Shrunk Me is an Early Access stealth game developed and published by Catland. It's basically a stealth game playing in the 1980's and you try to stop a sovjet nuke to launch on Washigton DC. It combines a lot of comedy and ''stealth'' cliches in the story.

[list]
[*][h1]Gameplay:[/h1]

[b]Stealth mechanics:[/b]
The mechanics as far as stealth goes are pretty good. You can peek and move pretty quickly and fluently, placing traps is also pretty nice although sometimes it is a little glitchy. Sometimes you might throw bananas ( yes,this is your equipment ) and if they fall a couple of inches next to the enemy it is basically considered a waste because you need to let the shells right on the area the enemies are going to walk, obvisouly you can pick the missed banana shell up if nobody is around the banana. The teleporter is a nice addition but in my walkthrough i barely used it mainly because other items felt more useful in my opinion. Keep in mind Sound and visibility barely play a role in this game. Overall it is a pretty basic experience but the movement feels so fluently, i would actually even say that it feels a lot like a dishonored game.

[b]AI opponents:[/b]
The AI isn't anything intelligent either as they barely see you or hear you. You throw a banana shell right in front of the enemies and the straight up ignore it. They cannot hear either as i found myself falling from upper sections and landing right next to them and they did not notice, the craziest thing is that in one mission i lit books on fire ( biographies ) and the guard was just standing in front of the fire scratching his head. What im trying to say is that the game is quite simple. When someone sees you they will run to press the alarm button and literally everyone in that area will rush to your position shooting with weapons, if you're able to survive this they will simply leave as if nothing happened. Believe me what i said right here might sound bad but it was extremely funny.

[*][h1]Story:[/h1]
The Games timeline is pretty cool aswell, 1980s Moscow.
You find youself in a train straight to Moscow after accepting a mission in order to stop Communist leader and overlord General Bolscotchkovich and his newly aquired Nazi mastermind  that created a world domination plan, using the shrink ray and some Nukes in order to get world domination but they did not expect AUDREY SMOOTHSPY to come inbetween their plans. Throughout the story you get past Russian dudes simply saying ''Lets drink some vodka after we take s h i t '', this is what i call comedy...
Now i do not want to spoil too much of the story because its rather short so i will let you find out youself. Keep in mind there are actually 4 different endings in the game.

[*][h1]Graphics/ Audio:[/h1]

Graphics:
 Visually the game will not really make you say ''WOW'' but it does its job with some funny sightings. Other than that there is not much detail visually in order to really point everything out. Simply said i would say that it doesn't look that good considering the required systems to run it.

Audio/Soundtrack:
The Voice Acting is amazing with clear sound, understandable texts and voices that simply match with each character perfectly.


[*][h1]Performance :[/h1]

On Low End Devices:
Not tested, probably doesn't run.
On High End Devices:
Intel Core i7 4790k, 16 GB RAM, Nvidia GTX 1070:
Game was running great with more than 60 fps on maxed out settings and Full HD resolution.
Performance will improve as the game reaches the full release.

[b]Bugs/ Glitches/ Crashes:[/b]
In 1,5 hours of intense gameplay i had no crashes neither any game breaking bugs and glitches which shows that the game is performing very well, for me atleast.

[*][h1]Price :[/h1]
For 8,19 Eur. you get a solid game that will probably improve with time, so i would suggest you give it a try! Although it would be better to wait for the game to improve or to wait for the sales.

[*][h1]Conclusion :[/h1]
I really suggest for anyone that is a comedy junkie and stealth fun to give this game a try because it was really a blast to play despite the limited hours. It is honestly a game where the devs invested a lot of time in order to make it feel so smooth giving me dishonored vibes. The whole idea is so random aswell which barely gives you the feeling of just another stealth game with weapons and overdramatic endings.

[h1]Overall Rating: 78/100[/h1]
